parameters.name: animal_types
parameters.description: set of animal types, indexed in 0-based order

parameters.name: planning_horizon
parameters.description: single planning horizon over which decisions are aggregated

parameters.name: unit_selling_price
parameters.description: unit selling price for each animal type

parameters.name: unit_feed_cost
parameters.description: unit feed cost for each animal type

parameters.name: manure_output
parameters.description: unit manure output for one animal of each type over the planning horizon

parameters.name: manure_capacity_max
parameters.description: maximum manure-handling capacity over the planning horizon

parameters.name: min_quantity
parameters.description: minimum required quantity for each animal type, inactive or null if no minimum applies

parameters.name: max_quantity
parameters.description: maximum allowed quantity for each animal type, inactive or null if no maximum applies

parameters.name: total_capacity_max
parameters.description: maximum total number of animals allowed across all types

variables.name: animal_quantity
variables.description: number of animals of each type to raise

variables.name: optimal_profit
variables.description: maximum total profit achieved by the selected livestock plan

constraints.name: nonnegative_integer_animal_quantities
constraints.description: all chosen animal quantities must be nonnegative integers

constraints.name: manure_capacity_limit
constraints.description: total manure generated by the selected livestock plan over the planning horizon must not exceed the manure-handling capacity

constraints.name: type_specific_minimum_quantity
constraints.description: for each animal type with an active minimum, the chosen quantity must meet the lower bound

constraints.name: type_specific_maximum_quantity
constraints.description: for each animal type with an active maximum, the chosen quantity must not exceed the upper bound

constraints.name: total_livestock_capacity_limit
constraints.description: the total number of animals raised across all types must not exceed the overall livestock capacity

objectives.name: profit_maximization
objectives.description: maximize total profit, defined as total selling revenue minus total feed cost

final_objective.description: maximize total profit, defined as total selling revenue minus total feed cost
